scripts.build:staging: tsc -b && VITE_I18N_PREVIEW_LOCALES=true vite build --mode staging && node scripts/build-pages-worker.mjs
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run verify:deploy-env && node scripts/verify-image-rollout-artifact.mjs staging && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=retrodesk-staging --branch=main
scripts.deploy:production: npm run verify:deploy-env && node scripts/verify-image-rollout-artifact.mjs production && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=retrodesk --branch=main
